change: GC always attempts unlink even after advisory stat NotFound. Only actual unlink success/trustworthy NotFound permits progress to parent barriers and reclamation receipt. Stat supplies diagnostic known-size accounting.

scope.formal: GCReceipt adds arbitrary stale presence metadata via separate ENV-GC-STAT. No eventual stat freshness premise; returning calls and trustworthy unlink/NotFound remain required. Existing Verus actual controller/index proofs rechecked, with no new complete proof of gc.rs syscall dispatch or stat-to-model refinement. No complete receipt liveness/ownership composition proof.
scope.diagnostics: Successful removal without a successful pre-unlink size observation counts one file and zero known bytes. reclaimed_bytes is not exact capacity accounting.
scope.limits: The repair prevents new false receipts; it does not automatically repair existing erroneous receipts. No natural stale-stat fault was observed. Injection tests stat only, not untrustworthy unlink NotFound. No 100 GB/TB data throughput rerun or new delay bound.

natural_visibility.scope: Fresh 2 KiB files after each reader primes a negative stat. Writer file+directory fsync completes before reader commands. Persistent SSH JSON pipes; no synchronized cross-host clock; no cache eviction or mount modification.

injected_gc.scope: Each fresh native publication contains a 2 KiB payload. One injected stat ENOENT; real unlink and directory sync. First GC timing includes tombstone, fault callback, removal, parent sync and receipt. Repeated GC and fresh-client replay verify durable receipt behavior. Baseline runs intentionally leave orphans, then explicitly remove only those private files; no production data is touched. No payload bandwidth or delay bound.

documentation_source.scope: Community documentation lists configurable negative lookup caching, disabled by default. Actual deployment mount options and unlink freshness are not inferred.

publication_redaction.scope: Public summary with deployment identifiers and private artifact locations removed.
publication_redaction.provenance: Embedded source/tool hashes describe the original execution inputs. This redacted JSON is not byte-identical to the original private record and is not a replacement for raw proof logs.
